items.title: Nordic nRF54LC10A – A tiny Bluetooth LE and 802.15.4 SoC with sub-50 nA hibernation mode
items.summary: Nordic Semiconductor recently expanded its nRF54L Series with the nRF54LC10A, a new SoC with less memory and a smaller peripheral set compared to the higher-end nRF54L15, while supporting Bluetooth LE with Channel Sounding and IEEE 802.15.4 for Thread, Zigbee, and Matter. Built on a 22nm process, the SoC combines a 128 MHz Arm Cortex-M33 processor with a multiprotocol 2.4 GHz radio. It also features a sub-50 nA hibernation mode for devices shipped with (3V) batteries installed, reducing battery drain during storage and transportation. Nordic Semiconductor nRF54LC10A specifications CPU Arm Cortex-M33 @ 128 MHz with DSP, FPU, MPU, and TrustZone 128 MHz RISC-V coprocessor (VPR) with I/O acceleration for SoftPeripherals and time-critical offload Performance – 239 CoreMark/mA, 503 CoreMark (preliminary) Memory – 192 KB RAM Storage – Up to 1012 KB NVM Wireless Bluetooth 5.4 LE with direction-finding, Bluetooth Mesh, etc. Ready for future Bluetooth releases Bluetooth Channel Sounding support for [...] The post Nordic nRF54LC10A – A tiny Bluetooth LE and 802.15.4 SoC with sub-50 nA hibernation mode appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.summary_zh: Nordic Semiconductor扩展nRF54L系列，发布nRF54LC10A SoC。采用22nm工艺，集成128 MHz Arm Cortex-M33与RISC-V协处理器VPR，支持蓝牙5.4 LE信道探测及IEEE 802.15.4协议，待机休眠电流低于50 nA。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 超低功耗设计适合电池供电物联网终端，内置RISC-V协处理器分担I/O负载

items.title: CVITEK CV1842H-P-based edge AI camera module offers night vision and AI-ISP support (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: The AIMORELOGY Ovis is an open-source AI vision camera module built around the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, with full-color 1080p night vision and 1.5 TOPS edge AI inference in a compact modular design. It is designed for drones, robotics, security systems, smart cameras, and custom embedded vision products. The camera features a compact stacked design, with a 20 × 20 mm Core board that includes the CVITEK CV1842H-P SoC, 2 Gbit NAND flash, USB, and UART debug pads. A Sensor board with the SC235HAI image sensor connects on top and also adds Ethernet and UART interfaces. An optional CVBS board goes between the Sensor board and the Ovis Core board. AIMORELOGY Ovis specifications: Ovis Core Board SoC – CVITEK CV1842H-P CPU – 1x Arm Cortex-A53 core @ 1.1 GHz, 1x RISC-V C906 core @ 800 MHz NPU – 1.5 TOPS @ INT8 with BF16 support ISP – AI-ISP with real-time 1080p [...] The post CVITEK CV1842H-P-based edge AI camera module offers night vision and AI-ISP support (Crowdfunding) appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers
items.summary: Last year, we saw Morse Micro introduce the MM8108 Wi-Fi HaLow (802.11ah) SoC with up to 43.33 Mbps throughput, along with an MM8108-RD09 USB dongle reference design, for which we had virtually no details at the time. Morse Micro has now released USB-A and USB-C Wi-Fi HaLow adapters based on that reference design. The adapters let PCs and routers connect to 802.11ah networks through USB without a dedicated expansion card and feature an external SMA antenna delivering up to 26 dBm transmit power. Wi-Fi HaLow USB network adapter specifications: SoC – Morse Micro MM8108 32-bit RISC-V Host Applications Processor (HAP) Standard – IEEE802.11ah Wi-Fi HaLow Frequency band – 850-950 MHz (Worldwide sub-1 GHz license-exempt range) Operating Modes – Access Point (AP) and Station (STA). Channel Width – 1/2/4/8 MHz Modulation – BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, 256QAM. Data rate – Up to 43.3 Mbps using 256-QAM modulation at an 8 MHz bandwidth [...] The post Morse Micro Wi-Fi HaLow USB adapters add 802.11ah connectivity to PCs and routers appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.why_it_matters_zh: 首款USB形态Wi-Fi HaLow适配器让现有设备便捷接入远距离低功耗sub-1GHz网络。

items.title: JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity
items.summary: JetKVM Mini is a smaller, lower-cost version of the popular JetKVM KVM over IP solution. The new model features a small information display, offers Ethernet or WiFi connectivity, and supports 1080p video capture. The main under-the-hood change is that they ditched Linux on a Rockchip RV1106G3 SoC and now rely on an ESP32-P4X (ESP32-P4 version 3.x and greater) to handle video capture, H.264 encoding, USB, and other features. The largest cost saving is removing the RAM and eMMC flash required by Linux. JetKVM Mini specifications: SoC – Espressif Systems ESP32-P4X CPU Dual-core 32-bit RISC-V HP (High-performance) CPU @ up to 400 MHz with AI instruction extension and single-precision FPU Single-RISC-V LP (Low-power) MCU core @ up to 40 MHz Memory 768 KB HP L2MEM (for dual-core CPU), 32 KB LP SRAM, 8 KB TCM (for LP MCU core) 32 MB PSRAM Storage – 128 KB HP ROM, 16 KB LP ROM [...] The post JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: JetKVM Mini：基于ESP32-P4X的低成本KVM设备
items.summary_zh: JetKVM推出新款低成本KVM over IP设备JetKVM Mini，采用乐鑫ESP32-P4X取代此前基于Linux的Rockchip RV1106G3方案。该SoC集成双核32位RISC-V HP CPU（最高400MHz）与单核LP MCU（40MHz），支持1080p视频采集、H.264编码及USB功能，并提供Ethernet或WiFi连接。省去RAM与eMMC flash，大幅降低BOM成本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: ESP32-P4X的RISC-V能力使JetKVM Mini无需Linux即可完成视频采集与编码，降低硬件成本，为嵌入式KVM方案树立新标杆。

items.title: ESP32-C5 Pico board follows Raspberry Pi Pico form factor, ships with on-board or external antenna
items.summary: Waveshare ESP32-C5 Pico board brings the ESP32-C5 dual-band WiFi 6, Bluetooth LE, and 802.15.4 (Zigbee/Thread) SoC to the Raspberry Pi Pico form factor. The board features an ESP32-C5-MINI-1 Series module with PCB or external antenna, two 20-pin GPIO headers, a USB-C port for power and programming, Reset and Boot buttons, and a few LEDs. It also supports Li-Ion battery charging and discharging. items.title: YuzukiNeko – A Linux-capable Allwinner F101 RISC-V SBC with Raspberry Pi Pico form factor
items.summary: YuzukiHD has made another open-source hardware Linux SBC. YuzukiNeko is a Raspberry Pi Pico-sized single board computer powered by a new Allwinner F101 RISC-V SoC. The Allwinner F101 processor features a single 1.008 GHz C907 RISC-V core, 8MB or 16 MB PSRAM, and support for various display interfaces such as MIPI DSI, 24-bit RGB, and LVDS. The YuzukiNeko board itself features the F101 SoC, an SPI NOR flash, a microSD card for storage, a USB-C port, and two 20-pin GPIO headers. items.title: choreographr/choreographr updated on GitHub
items.summary: Choreographr is an all purpose extensible AI agent system written entirely in Rust. It has a client/server architecture and can run many sessions simulataneously. It can be run locally or in the cloud. LLM generated code can be run in a sandboxed RISC-V VM for complete security and observability. Stars: 5.
items.title_zh: GitHub上choreographr仓库更新
items.summary_zh: choreographr 是一个完全使用 Rust 编写的可扩展 AI 代理系统，采用客户端/服务器架构，支持本地与云端部署。其亮点是大语言模型（LLM）生成的代码可在沙盒化的 RISC-V 虚拟机中运行，以提供安全性和可观测性，目前获得 5 个 Star。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 利用 RISC-V VM 沙盒执行 LLM 代码，为 AI 代理安全隔离提供了新方案。

items.title: rtCarl/ultraviolet updated on GitHub
items.summary: 🛠️ Build a RISC-native architecture combining RISC-V/ARM CPUs and CUDA GPUs on OpenBSD for a streamlined, secure, and efficient computing experience. Stars: 0.
items.title_zh: GitHub项目rtCarl/ultraviolet：构建RISC-V/ARM与CUDA GPU异构架构
items.summary_zh: GitHub项目rtCarl/ultraviolet尝试在OpenBSD上整合RISC-V与ARM CPU以及CUDA GPU，构建精简、安全、高效的RISC原生计算架构。该项目目前Star数为0，仍处于早期阶段。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 探索异构架构在BSD系统上的整合可能，为开源生态提供新选择，但项目尚处于早期阶段。

items.title: AMD Begins Preparing Open-Source Linux Driver For Graphics Cards With GDDR7
items.summary: AMD sent out their latest Linux kernel graphics driver patches today for enabling some new hardware IP blocks. And as part of that, preparing for GDDR7 video memory with the AMDGPU driver...
items.title_zh: AMD开始为搭载GDDR7显存的显卡准备开源Linux驱动
items.summary_zh: AMD近日向Linux内核提交最新图形驱动补丁，为部分新硬件IP模块的启用做准备，其中包含在AMGPU驱动中加入对GDDR7显存支持的相关代码。
items.why_it_matters_zh: GDDR7支持预示AMD下一代Radeon显卡即将到来，开源驱动的提前准备有助于Linux社区及时适配。

items.title: Patches Posted For Enabling Apple Silicon Mac Speaker & Headset Jack Support On Linux
items.summary: While the downstream Asahi Linux kernel has offered working speaker support and headset jack capabilities on Apple Silicon Macs, the mainline Linux kernel hasn't supported this functionality. But a set of 28 patches sent out today on the Linux kernel mailing list are working toward mainlining this important functionality for using Apple Macs on the upstream Linux desktop...
items.title_zh: 补丁提交：Linux主线内核将支持Apple Silicon Mac扬声器与耳机插孔
items.summary_zh: Asahi Linux下游内核已支持Apple Silicon Mac的扬声器与耳机插孔功能，但主线Linux内核一直缺失该能力。开发者今日向Linux内核邮件列表提交了28个补丁，致力于将这一重要功能合入上游内核，方便用户在主流Linux桌面环境中使用Mac硬件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 补丁合入后将显著提升Mac设备在Linux桌面上的硬件兼容性与日常使用体验。

items.title: AMD EPYC Server Performance Up ~8% Geo Mean For 2026 With Linux Kernel Improvements
items.summary: With the in-development Linux 7.3 kernel showing some nice performance improvements over Linux 7.2 in different areas, Linux 7.2 also having brought some nice gains especially for I/O, and the preceding kernels also having seen some nice performance optimizations this year, I wanted to measure how far the Linux kernel performance has evolved so far in 2026. Today's article is looking at that with how the Linux kernel performance has evolved since the Linux 6.18 LTS kernel at the end of 2025 to the current Linux 7.3 kernel.
items.title_zh: Linux内核持续优化，AMD EPYC服务器2026年性能提升约8%
items.summary_zh: Phoronix对Linux 6.18 LTS（2025年末）至开发版7.3内核进行了基准对比测试。结果显示，AMD EPYC服务器整体性能获得约8%的几何平均提升，其中Linux 7.3相较7.2在多个领域表现优异，7.2在I/O方面也带来明显增益，全年内核优化效果显著。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 持续的内核优化可显著提升数据中心服务器性能表现，帮助企业释放硬件潜力。

items.title: Patches Posted With Aim To Mainline Linux Kernel Support For The Amazon Kindle 4
items.summary: Amazon released the Kindle 4 back in 2011 with a 6-inch E-ink display, 2GB internal storage, and running a modified version of Linux. In the years since the Amazon Kindle 4 has been jail-broken and there are some customized Linux distributions with a patched kernel to run on the Kindle 4. Now in 2026 there are patches on the Linux kernel mailing list looking to mainline support for that fifteen year old e-reader device...

items.title: Orphaned VMs: Running VMs Uninterrupted While Host Kernel Is Offline For Reboots/Updates
items.summary: Here's some very intriguing work taking place by a Google engineer... With the hyperscalers and other cloud providers pushing for zero-downtime, a set of experimental patches for "Orphaned VMs" allow for the virtual machines to continue to run while the host kernel is offline for security updates or rebooting with the Live Update Orchestrator. The experimental patches and request for feedback from other Linux kernel stakeholders was sent out this weekend on Orphaned VMs...

The experimental patches and request for feedback from other Linux kernel stakeholders was sent out this weekend on Orphaned VMs...

items.title: AMD BC-250 Continues Being Improved Under Linux With Patches Now Enabling The PSP
items.summary: The AMD BC-250 as the product designed at the time for cryptocurrency mining and based on a cut-down Sony PlayStation 5 APU continues having an interesting second-life being re-tasked for Linux use from general purpose workloads to AI. Sent out this weekend were the latest Linux kernel patches for continuing to enable more of the BC-250...
items.title_zh: AMD BC-250 在 Linux 下持续改进，新补丁启用 PSP
items.summary_zh: AMD BC-250 最初为加密货币挖矿设计，基于索尼 PS5 APU 的精简版本，如今在 Linux 上迎来第二春，被重新用于通用计算和 AI 负载。本周末发布的最新 Linux 内核补丁进一步启用了更多 BC-250 功能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: BC-250 在 Linux 上的复用展现了 PS5 APU 的灵活性，拓展了其在 AI 等领域的应用潜力。

items.title: Linux's Perf Script Command Much Faster With Overhaul As Python Module
items.summary: A big patch series sent out this weekend for the Linux kernel's perf subsystem removes the embedded Python and Perl scripting in favor of standalone Python scripts with a new Python perf module. This perf module for Python written in C is much faster than the status quo...
items.title_zh: Linux perf 脚本命令重构，性能大幅提升
items.summary_zh: 本周末提交的大型补丁系列移除了 Linux 内核 perf 子系统中内嵌的 Python 和 Perl 脚本，改用独立的 Python 脚本配合新的 Python perf 模块。该模块以 C 编写，相比现有方案速度显著提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: perf 工具重构带来明显性能提升，为内核开发者提供更高效的分析调试手段。

items.title: Apple Video Decode Driver Posted For Upstream Linux Kernel Review
items.summary: The latest Apple Silicon enablement code working its way from the Asahi Linux project toward the upstream Linux kernel is the AVD driver used for accelerated video playback across Apple M1 / M2 / M3 SoCs...
items.title_zh: Asahi Linux提交Apple AVD视频解码驱动以纳入上游Linux内核
items.summary_zh: Asahi Linux项目正将面向Apple Silicon的AVD（Apple Video Decoder）加速视频解码驱动提交至Linux上游内核进行审查，该驱动可在M1、M2、M3等SoC上实现硬件加速视频播放，是其逆向工程Apple GPU与媒体子系统的最新进展。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这将补齐Apple Silicon在Linux下的硬件视频解码能力，对Linux-on-Apple生态与开源驱动成熟度具有重要意义。

items.title: XIAO SAMD21 Plus and RP2040 Plus USB-C boards get additional GPIO pins, integrated Li-ion battery management
items.summary: Seeed Studio has expanded its XIAO Plus Series introduced in 2025, with the XIAO SAMD21 Plus and XIAO RP2040 Plus USB-C boards adding several GPIOs and integrated Li-ion battery management to the XIAO (SAMD21) and XIAO RP2040, launched in 2020 and 2021, respectively, while keeping the same form factor. XIAO SAMD21 Plus Specifications: MCU – Microchip SAMD21G18 Arm Cortex-M0+ microcontroller at up to 48MHz with 256KB Flash,32KB SRAM USB – 1x USB Type-C port for power and programming Expansion I/Os 2x 7-pin “legacy” headers with 11x analog inputs, 11x digital I/Os, 1x DAC, SPI, UART, and I2C Castellated holes and pads with 16x digital I/Os, I2C,and I2S 3.3V I/O voltage (not 5V tolerant) Misc Reset and Boot buttons RGB LED Charge LED Power Supply 5V via USB-C port Pads for battery On-board PMIC Dimensions – 23.5×17.5 mm Temperature Range – -40°C ~ 85°C The upgraded variant of the XIAO SAMD21 [...] The post XIAO SAMD21 Plus and RP2040 Plus USB-C boards get additional GPIO pins, integrated Li-ion battery management appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: Seeed Studio扩展XIAO Plus系列，推出SAMD21与RP2040 USB-C升级版开发板
items.summary_zh: Seeed Studio在2025年推出的XIAO Plus系列基础上，新增XIAO SAMD21 Plus和XIAO RP2040 Plus两款USB-C开发板，在保留原有小巧外形的同时增加GPIO引脚，并集成锂电池充电管理，分别搭载Microchip SAMD21G18和Raspberry Pi RP2040双核MCU。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 升级版在保持极小尺寸的同时改善供电管理与I/O扩展性，适合便携式、可穿戴及电池供电的嵌入式原型开发。

items.title: Brainchip AKD1500 M.2 and PCIe Edge AI cards, BrainBoard 1500 SPI module now available for $99 and up
items.summary: Back in November 2025, we wrote about the Brainchip AKD1500 PCIe/SPI Edge AI co-processor designed for low-power systems and delivering up to 800 GOPS at just 300 mW. In recent months, the company has launched several hardware platforms based on the ADK1500. At the end of July, Brainchip introduced the AKD1500 M.2 B+M Key development card for $129, shortly followed by the $99 BrainBoard 1500 module in August, and a few days ago, the company started selling the AKD1500 PCIe development card for $149. Brainchip AKD1500 M.2 B+M Key development card Specifications: AI accelerator – AKD1500 neuromorphic co-processor Akida Neuron Fabric clocked at 5 to 400 MHz 1MB on-chip Local memory 800 GOPS at less than 300 mW Adaptive on-chip learning, no cloud required Package – 7×7 mm MFCTFBGA169 package, 0.5 mm pitch Process – 22 nm FD-SOI CMOS digital logic process Host Interface – B+M Key edge connector for [...] The post Brainchip AKD1500 M.2 and PCIe Edge AI cards, BrainBoard 1500 SPI module now available for $99 and up appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: BrainChip推出AKD1500系列Edge AI开发硬件,起售价99美元
items.summary_zh: BrainChip基于AKD1500神经形态协处理器推出三款Edge AI开发平台,包括售价129美元的M.2 B+M Key卡、99美元的BrainBoard 1500 SPI模块以及149美元的PCIe开发卡。该芯片采用22nm FD-SOI工艺,搭载Akida Neuron Fabric,功耗低于300毫瓦,算力最高达800 GOPS,支持片上自适应学习,无需依赖云端。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 神经形态处理器以低于300mW的功耗提供800 GOPS算力,并支持本地自适应学习,为低功耗边缘AI设备提供了兼具推理与学习能力的高效方案。
